description: Eager to dive into NASA and explore things.
summary: EXOARCHIVE – The Last Diary of Opportunity is an interactive storytelling website developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Inspired by NASA's Discarded Equipment Storytelling challenge, it transforms the journey of NASA's Mars rover Opportunity into an engaging digital experience. Through imaginative first-person diary entries, real NASA mission data, images, timelines, and interactive quizzes, users explore the rover's landing, scientific discoveries, challenges, and final communication. The project combines science, technology, and storytelling to make space exploration accessible and emotionally engaging. Its main objective is to preserve the legacy of robotic explorers, promote scientific curiosity, and transform NASA's mission data into meaningful stories for students and the public.
details: EXOARCHIVE is an interactive storytelling website that transforms NASA's Mars rover Opportunity mission into an engaging digital experience. It combines imaginative rover diary entries with NASA mission facts, images, timelines, and quizzes. Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the project requires no specialized hardware. It makes space science accessible, promotes scientific curiosity, and preserves the legacy of robotic explorers. Its creativity lies in presenting real scientific information through a rover's perspective, creating an emotional connection with users. Key considerations include scientific accuracy, educational value, accessibility, simplicity, and user engagement. The intended impact is to inspire students and the public to explore space science through interactive storytelling.
